emotional_tone: High-precision professional video editing studio, dark cinematic theme, fast, sleek, tactile CapCut/Descript alternative

key_features_layout.name: Home Dashboard & Upload Area
key_features_layout.description: Hero section with ClipForge logo (Scissors + Play button), subtitle 'Trasforma i tuoi video in clip pronte per Shorts, Reels e TikTok', large drag-and-drop upload zone with support for MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, sample video loader button, and a recent projects grid ('Progetti recenti') with thumbnails, clip counts, duration, date and context action menus.

key_features_layout.name: Uploaded Video Info Panel
key_features_layout.description: Card showing video summary details (Filename, duration, 4K/1080p resolution, FPS, file size, audio tracks), interactive video player preview with play/pause, and a prominent 'Continua alla configurazione' button.

key_features_layout.name: Impostazioni Clip Screen
key_features_layout.description: Settings view with Aspect Ratio selector (9:16 vertical, 16:9 landscape, 1:1 square), Clip Duration choices (15s, 30s, 45s, 60s, custom slider), Number of Clips (1, 3, 5, 10), and AI toggles for Sottotitoli automatici, Auto Zoom, Auto Crop, Tracking del volto, Normalizzazione audio, and 'Trova i momenti migliori' mode.

key_features_layout.name: Video Editor Workstation
key_features_layout.description: Professional 3-pane video workspace: Left = Canvas video preview with 9:16 safe-zone overlay and live subtitle preview; Right = Settings tabs (Ritaglio, Sottotitoli, Audio, Layout); Bottom = Multi-track timeline with scrubber playhead, In/Out trim handles, split, play/pause, volume, speed control (0.5x-2x), and timeline zoom slider.

key_features_layout.name: Subtitle Style Editor
key_features_layout.description: Subtitle customizer with style presets (Classico, Bold Highlight, Gaming Neon, Minimalist), live editable preview, font selection, text size slider, position Y control, fill color picker, background highlight toggle/color, text shadow and outline controls.

key_features_layout.name: Export & Queue Screen
key_features_layout.description: Batch processing queue showing real progress percentage bar ('Elaborazione 34%'), status per clip (Completata, In elaborazione, In coda), video preview dialog, individual download buttons, and 'Scarica tutte le clip (.zip)' button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app is in Italian language with accurate terminology ('Trascina qui il tuo video', 'Sottotitoli', 'Esporta clip', 'Piattaforme destinate', etc.).
Implement clear flow state navigation (Upload -> Info Panel -> Impostazioni Clip -> Editor Workspace -> Subtitle Styling -> Queue Export) so all key functionalities can be tested smoothly.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, input sliders, toggles, trim handles, project cards, and export progress elements for test automation.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdown menus or floating dialogs; use glassmorphism with backdrop blur and explicit dark background opacity.
Include sample media assets (like built-in demo video clips) so users can test the editor without having to upload a large local file if they prefer.
Keep the dark-mode aesthetic clean, with cyan `#00E5FF` high-visibility highlights, slate dark cards, and JetBrains Mono timestamps.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow dark mode professional video editor aesthetics, no purple AI gradients, generous spacing, explicit interactive state styling, and full data-testid coverage.
